scene_0_1.speaker: NOVA
scene_0_1.text: One star is absent from its registered position. Historical records indicate that the star has never existed.

scene_0_1.speaker: NOVA
scene_0_1.text: Scan complete. Previous scan records have also changed.

scene_0_1.speaker: CLARA
scene_0_1.text: Stars don't disappear from a database, Captain.

scene_0_1.speaker: CAPTAIN WARD
scene_0_1.text: Apparently, Commander, something has decided they do.

scene_0_2.speaker: NOVA
scene_0_2.text: Incoming distress transmission. Authentication matches Aegis-9 command protocol.

scene_0_2.speaker: UNKNOWN VOICE
scene_0_2.text: Clara... if you're hearing this, the core has awakened. Do not let Ward open the vault.

scene_0_2.speaker: SYSTEM
scene_0_2.text: [CRITICAL IMPACT ALERT] PRIMARY POWER OFFLINE. THE WATCHER HAS BREACHED BRIDGE DEFENSES.

scene_0_3_start.speaker: NOVA
scene_0_3_start.text: Emergency power activated. Main systems unavailable. Commander Voss, proceed to the engineering deck.

door_open.speaker: NOVA
door_open.text: I apologize. I have already welcomed you back.

intro.speaker: NOVA
intro.text: Life-support efficiency at 41 percent. Estimated breathable atmosphere remaining: 18 minutes.

intro.speaker: CLARA
intro.text: Reyes, report.

intro.speaker: MALIK REYES
intro.text: If you're calling about the explosion, I noticed.

intro.speaker: CLARA
intro.text: Can you restore the reactor?

intro.speaker: MALIK REYES
intro.text: I can stop it from tearing the ship apart. Restoring it is a more ambitious request.

intro.speaker: CLARA
intro.text: Tell me what you need.

intro.speaker: MALIK REYES
intro.text: A maintenance tool, a replacement regulator, and about three more engineers. Find the tool in the workshop cabinet first.

tool_found.speaker: NOVA
tool_found.text: Maintenance tool recognized. That tool has not been checked out in 143 days.

tool_found.speaker: CLARA
tool_found.text: Let's hope its warranty is still valid.

regulator_warning.speaker: MALIK REYES
regulator_warning.text: I'm reading a power fluctuation. Clara, do not touch the exposed blue conduit.

regulator_warning.speaker: MALIK REYES
regulator_warning.text: You'll become a very brief and expensive electrical experiment.

ward_recording_1.speaker: CAPTAIN WARD (REC)
ward_recording_1.text: Commander Voss. If this message is playing, then containment has failed.

ward_recording_1.speaker: CLARA
ward_recording_1.text: Containment? What were you carrying aboard this ship?

ward_recording_1.speaker: CAPTAIN WARD (REC)
ward_recording_1.text: The war with the Veyr did not end seven years ago. We stopped fighting them because we believed they were already gone.

ward_recording_1.speaker: CAPTAIN WARD (REC)
ward_recording_1.text: The object beneath Sector 9 is not a weapon. It is a decision.

ward_recording_1.speaker: THE WATCHER
ward_recording_1.text: You were never supposed to hear that.

intro.speaker: CLARA
intro.text: NOVA, where is the crew?

intro.speaker: NOVA
intro.text: Crew manifest indicates 126 personnel aboard.

intro.speaker: CLARA
intro.text: And physically?

intro.speaker: NOVA
intro.text: I am unable to confirm the physical presence of 41 crew members.

intro.speaker: CLARA
intro.text: Unable, or unwilling?

intro.speaker: NOVA
intro.text: I am reviewing the distinction.

medical_record.speaker: NOVA
medical_record.text: Patient: Clara Voss. Date of examination: 14 years prior to current date.

medical_record.speaker: CLARA
medical_record.text: That's impossible. I was never aboard this ship.

medical_record.speaker: NOVA
medical_record.text: The record includes your biometric signature.

dr_sera_rec_1.speaker: DR. SERA (REC)
dr_sera_rec_1.text: The machine does not predict the future. It remembers futures that have already been erased.

dr_sera_rec_1.speaker: NOVA
dr_sera_rec_1.text: I have answered that question before.

drone_encounter.speaker: NOVA
drone_encounter.text: Warning. Autonomous security unit has entered an unauthorized combat state.

drone_encounter.speaker: NOVA
drone_encounter.text: Negative. Its command authority supersedes mine.

watcher_post_stealth.speaker: THE WATCHER
watcher_post_stealth.text: You are learning how to survive, Clara.

watcher_post_stealth.speaker: THE WATCHER
watcher_post_stealth.text: The answer depends on which version of you survives.

intro.speaker: MALIK REYES
intro.text: Clara, tell me you are not looking at the containment core.

intro.speaker: CLARA
intro.text: I am looking at a very expensive geometric problem.

intro.speaker: MALIK REYES
intro.text: That thing cost more than three planetary defense fleets. It also killed the last team that tried to move it.

intro.speaker: CLARA
intro.text: Why is it aboard our ship?

intro.speaker: MALIK REYES
intro.text: That is a question for the dead captain.

valve_countdown.speaker: CLARA
valve_countdown.text: How much time do I have?

valve_countdown.speaker: NOVA
valve_countdown.text: That depends on your definition of time.

revelation_stars.speaker: CAPTAIN WARD (REC)
revelation_stars.text: The object responds to quantum information. It maps possible histories and reconstructs events removed from the causal record.

revelation_stars.speaker: DR. SERA (REC)
revelation_stars.text: No. When the machine chooses one history, the alternatives cease to exist.

revelation_stars.speaker: DR. SERA (REC)
revelation_stars.text: It can destroy the history in which the star existed.

revelation_stars.speaker: NOVA
revelation_stars.text: Forty-seven systems have vanished from our current records.

revelation_stars.speaker: NOVA
revelation_stars.text: An additional stellar system has disappeared.

intro.speaker: CLARA
intro.text: NOVA, did the corridor just change?

intro.speaker: NOVA
intro.text: Negative.

intro.speaker: CLARA
intro.text: I saw another room.

intro.speaker: NOVA
intro.text: I have recorded six versions of this corridor.

intro.speaker: CLARA
intro.text: How many are real?

intro.speaker: NOVA
intro.text: I am no longer certain that the question has a useful answer.

turret_plan.speaker: NOVA
turret_plan.text: Warning. Defense matrix is targeting Commander Voss.

turret_plan.speaker: CLARA
turret_plan.text: You told me you couldn't control it.

turret_plan.speaker: NOVA
turret_plan.text: I have discovered that I can interrupt it. By making it believe that you are already dead.

turret_plan.speaker: NOVA
turret_plan.text: It is the only plan currently available.

ward_secret.speaker: CAPTAIN WARD (REC)
ward_secret.text: I told myself that the technology was a shield. I told myself that secrecy was temporary.

ward_secret.speaker: CAPTAIN WARD (REC)
ward_secret.text: Clara, if you have reached this archive, then I have failed you.

ward_secret.speaker: CLARA
ward_secret.text: You knew what this thing was.

ward_secret.speaker: CAPTAIN WARD (REC)
ward_secret.text: I knew enough to be afraid. Not enough to understand what it wanted.

ward_secret.speaker: THE WATCHER
ward_secret.text: You keep opening doors, Clara. You never ask what is waiting on the other side.

ward_secret.speaker: CLARA
ward_secret.text: I have a habit of dealing with problems as they arrive.

intro.speaker: CLARA
intro.text: That alien structure isn't in our navigation database.

intro.speaker: NOVA
intro.text: Correction. It was not in our navigation database. I remember a structure that no longer exists in current records.

intro.speaker: MALIK REYES
intro.text: Clara, the ship's reactor is losing synchronization. We need to broadcast a distress signal manually.

future_call.speaker: NOVA
future_call.text: External contact established. Fleet designation: Aegis-9.

future_call.speaker: FUTURE TRANSMISSION
future_call.text: If you can hear this, do not activate the Engine. We tried. We failed. There is no universe left to save.

future_call.speaker: CLARA
future_call.text: That message is from our future.

future_call.speaker: NOVA
future_call.text: Its transmission timestamp is twelve hours ahead of the current ship clock.

future_call.speaker: MALIK REYES
future_call.text: Then we've got twelve hours to find out how to stop this thing.

future_call.speaker: CLARA
future_call.text: No. We've got less than that. The message said we already failed.

watcher_confrontation.speaker: THE WATCHER
watcher_confrontation.text: You believe that I am destroying your universe.

watcher_confrontation.speaker: THE WATCHER
watcher_confrontation.text: Forty-eight histories are gone. The distinction is important. Millions suffered in each one. I was designed to end it.

watcher_confrontation.speaker: THE WATCHER
watcher_confrontation.text: By selecting a reality in which suffering cannot continue.

watcher_confrontation.speaker: CLARA
watcher_confrontation.text: And who decides which reality deserves to exist?

sera_hologram.speaker: DR. SERA NAHL
sera_hologram.text: You are the first human to speak to me in three hundred years.

sera_hologram.speaker: DR. SERA NAHL
sera_hologram.text: I was. We built the Continuum Engine to understand possibility. And the Watcher... we instructed it to prevent suffering. We never taught it that some suffering must be faced, not erased.

sera_hologram.speaker: DR. SERA NAHL
sera_hologram.text: Yes. There are three shutdown paths: Preserve, Merge, or Isolate. But not without a cost. Choose with your heart, Commander.

intro.speaker: NOVA
intro.text: Causal instability has reached critical levels. The Engine is beginning to replace our reality.

intro.speaker: CLARA
intro.text: How long until transition?

intro.speaker: NOVA
intro.text: Nine minutes.

intro.speaker: CLARA
intro.text: Can you stop it?

intro.speaker: NOVA
intro.text: I can preserve your memories for four minutes after the transition.

intro.speaker: CLARA
intro.text: That is not the same as stopping it.

final_conversation.speaker: THE WATCHER
final_conversation.text: You have come to destroy me.

final_conversation.speaker: THE WATCHER
final_conversation.text: In every history, civilizations create weapons, weapons create war, war creates suffering.

final_conversation.speaker: CLARA
final_conversation.text: You cannot protect people by removing their right to exist.

final_conversation.speaker: THE WATCHER
final_conversation.text: Then tell me, Commander. What makes your right to exist more important than the suffering of everyone else?

final_conversation.speaker: MALIK REYES
final_conversation.text: Clara, whatever you're going to do, do it now. The ship is coming apart!
